column1: # Measured GPU classes for saver candidates that are NOT in the ship set yet (tiers.tsv only accepts shipped ids).
# Same columns and rule as tiers.tsv, produced by tools/measure-tiers.py from results.json files built from the harness [stats] line
# (fps = steady frames / steady seconds, p95 = steady p95). Hosts: build-host UHD 630 and Navi14, MS-R1 Mali-G720 at the 1080p cap.
# The ephemeris build-host runs overlapped the system Black Hole screensaver on the Navi14 (it still held 60 fps);
# the magmasimplex runs had ncz-screensaver-idled stopped. LEAD 21 re-measures both on the test hosts.
# Move a row into tiers.tsv when its id enters ncz_ship_bins.
# magmasimplex (LEAD 25, sixties engine): worst view per cell, 30 s runs, idled stopped, host lock held; uhd630 via DRI_PRIME offload
# on build-host (native = scale 1.0 light quality, inside view), navi14 = build-host display GPU; Mali-G720 measured on O6N (MS-R1 was locked).

# xshadertoy_leviathan_gles3 (LEAD 24): in-session [stats] runs at 9 arc times (--start-time), each cell the worst act (lowest fps, highest p95); build-host UHD 630 and RTX 2060, MS-R1 Mali-G720 at the 1080p cap; idled stopped during the runs.
